content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean closer, brushing his arm with mine ||| "What if I let you decide the next question?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, releasing my grip on the blade ||| "I won't answer until I know what's truly at stake."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, my heart racing ||| "I can't shake the feeling that you're more than this."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tighter, standing firm ||| "I'll determine the terms of this ritual, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, feeling the weight of the moment |||
